violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Blade on the large can opener has debris on it.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Fans in the walk in cooler are dusty.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not covered or inverted during storage. -Clean plates in the kitchen are not inverted.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. -Raw beef and raw pork stacked together on the bottom shelf in the walk in cooler.
